# AppOutput

A named output an app run set with one of the `AppStateSetOutput…` calls.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` | The output's name, as the app set it. |
| `type` | [`AppDataType`](app-data-type.md) | The type of the value, from the call that set it. |
| `value` | `string \| null` | The value, as text (JSON for `JsonObject` and `JsonArray`). |
| `date` | `datetime` | When the output was last set, in UTC. |

## Example

```json
{
  "name": "...",
  "type": "String",
  "value": "...",
  "date": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z"
}
```

## Where it's used

- Inside [`AppProcess`](app-process.md)
- Inside [`AppProcessWithDetails`](app-process-with-details.md)
